typography.rules: Do not use Inter. Use tracking-tight for headings > 32px. IBM Plex Sans provides excellent legibility for numbers and dense data in POS environments. Line-height should be leading-none for headers and leading-relaxed for body.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating elements, otherwise flat.
visual_enhancers.borders: Grid borders pattern for data tables. 1px solid borders for menu items.
visual_enhancers.interactions: Active states must have high contrast (e.g., bg-gray-900 text-white). Touch-feedback scale (active:scale-95) for POS buttons.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Huge touch targets on POS (min-h-[64px]). Use primary color for main action, subtle gray for secondary.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow for dashboard. KDS tickets should have top colored border to indicate status.
components.modals: Slide-out sheets (Shadcn Sheet) preferred over center dialogs for POS to keep context.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs with large padding (p-4) for tablet tap targets.

grids.pos_menu_grid: Dense bento grid, grid-cols-3 or grid-cols-4 for menu items to allow fast scanning.
grids.kds_grid: Masonry or flexible grid (grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) for ticket cards. No gaps at the bottom.
grids.floor_plan: CSS Grid or absolute positioning canvas for drag-and-drop tables.

layouts.pos_tablet: Top row for active tables/alerts. Middle area split: left 2/3 for menu grid, right 1/3 for current order ticket. Bottom rail for main navigation.
layouts.kds_tablet: Full width, no sidebars. Top bar for filter (All, Grill, Fryer). Remaining space for active tickets.
layouts.mobile_public: Mobile-first. Sticky category horizontal scroll navigation. Bottom sheet pattern for cart. Big sticky CTA at the bottom for 'Ordina ora'.
layouts.spacing: Use p-4 to p-6 for POS grids to maximize touch targets. p-8 for dashboard summaries.

motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform). Avoid transition-all.
motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) for menu cards, background darkening for buttons.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for KDS tickets so new orders pop in cleanly.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA minimum contrast. POS environment needs extremely high contrast due to glare.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px touch targets for mobile, 64x64px for POS tablets.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none).

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for POS/Dashboard for clear, readable iconography. lucide-react as fallback.
media.images: Hero images must have max opacity bg-black/40 overlay. Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

3d_libraries.usage: Not required for this MVP as it is an operational dashboard. Use framer-motion for drag-and-drop table layouts if needed, but 3D is overkill.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the UI is entirely in Italian (e.g., 'Tavoli', 'Ordini', 'Prenotazioni', 'Impostazioni', 'Gestione Menu').
Implement light mode for POS/Dashboard, but strictly Dark Mode for the KDS (Kitchen Display System).
Floor plan editor needs to be a drag-and-drop grid interface. Tables should be visually distinct based on status (Libero = Green, Occupato = Orange/Red, In attesa = Blue).
For the KDS, use a Masonry or flexible grid layout for ticket cards. They must have clear, large text and a 'Completa' button with massive touch targets.
Avoid deep navigation. Core POS actions must be max 2 taps away. Use Shadcn Sheet/Drawer for side-panel order editing rather than full page navigations.
Do not use generic SaaS gradients; keep it flat, high-contrast, and operational (Lightspeed/Toast style).
For public mobile QR ordering, ensure a sticky 'Carrello' (Cart) button at the bottom of the screen.
Install and use 'sonner' for toast notifications, and ensure data-testid is present on all interactive elements.
Create a Super-admin view to manage and list tenants (restaurants).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center-align the app container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Large touch targets are critical for POS.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons.
Add transition for specific interactive elements (e.g. transition-colors duration-200), do NOT use 'transition-all'.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep operational UI flat and fast.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
